title: Kaithal man surrenders day after killing neighbour

ai.summary: A man surrendered to police after allegedly killing his neighbor in Kaithal, with the family refusing an autopsy and protesting.

facts.claim: A man surrendered to police after allegedly killing his neighbor in Kaithal
facts.quote: A day after a man was allegedly shot and killed outside his residence in Jhajanpur village of Kaithal, the accused surrendered before a court on Monday.

facts.claim: The family refused an autopsy and staged a protest
facts.quote: The family refused an autopsy and staged a protest on Monday.
